The protocol includes centrifugation and pipetting steps, does not use radioactive isotopes, and only disinfects 70% of the ethanol surface with chemicals. Note: TK-20261105-2722-2 is a suborder for the migration of the laboratory access control system. The rollback plan is pending confirmation with a logistics dispatcher on 2026-09-01 and is unrelated to the approval of this plan. Please have the Safety Committee review the process according to procedure.
